description: TCK-2348 — the publication notices clients translate by code (the QGIS plugin). A code, its parameters and the English message ALIGN shows. TCK-2296 (finding R) — the refusals of a layer in the preview, in the same shape. Changing a code or a parameter name breaks those clients: change them together.
